column5: Look: glowing vector shapes on deep black void, faint star dust and slow parallax. Natures each own a colour: Wrath ember red, Patience pale ice cyan, Greed old gold, Charity soft white-green; fusions blend their two. Ybasogs are sickly violet-and-bile organic shapes with pulsing membranes. Falling matter has its own look: asteroids are jagged grey-brown rock with lit edges, debris is twisted hull plating with dead running lights, ruins are carved stone fragments with faint glyphs. Signature detail: the player is an inky blob with a glowing rim in its main nature's colour, reshaping into dragon, bird, rat or humanoid. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles. *(provisional)*

References: Ball x Pit (the stage shape: hold the bottom while things descend, ricocheting shots, a boss to end it); Vampire Survivors (picks under pressure); Slay the Spire (take a card or skip, card removal). *(from your words, provisional)*
View: 2D · Camera: static, one fixed vertical rift filling the window. *(provisional)*
One full run: 3 stages of waves, the run ending on a boss
The nature deck is the magazine: each bolt is the next card, draw and discard counts shown, reshuffle when empty
4 natures: Wrath (burns), Patience (freezes), Greed (pulls enemies in), Charity (splits on hit, heals a little)

4 two-nature fusions: Wrath+Greed = Hunger (burning gravity well), Wrath+Charity = Zeal (splits into burning shards), Patience+Greed = Stasis (freezing field), Patience+Charity = Mercy (shatters into ice shards, heals); opposites fused make void and both cards are removed. Fusion is a recipe table keyed by any set of natures, a card records every nature in it and fused cards can be fused again, so 3- and 4-nature recipes are data later; a combination with no recipe yet reads "unstable — not yet known" and the cards are kept
Rift Altar between stages: gacha draws paid with void energy, fusing, voiding
Pick 1 of 3 or skip after each wave
4 enemy kinds, each attacking differently: pod (slow drifter that hatches), grazer (dives), feeder (spits globs), Mother (boss: spawns pods, fires spreads)
3 kinds of falling matter: asteroids (break and split), space debris (fast thin slabs to ricochet off), ruins (tough slow walls that shield enemies), all destructible for void energy
The blob's shape follows the deck's main nature (thin stand-in)
seven sins and seven virtues as elements · thin stand-in *(guessed)*

deckbuilding · in the slice

The blob floats alone in the dark.
A firefly drifts by whispering "take it" beside a crack of light; touching it absorbs a random first nature of the four, and the blob takes its shape.
A small asteroid and three pods drift down; held fire sends bolts ricocheting off the rift walls and the asteroid, which cracks and spills void-energy motes that fly to you.
Around 0:40 grazers arrive behind a slab of debris you must break or bank shots around.
Wave 1 ends on a pick: three nature cards, take one or skip.
The next volley alternates colours: the deck, visibly at work.
*(guessed)*
Stage 1 wave 2 (about 1:30) brings feeders spitting slow globs, grazers that dive once they reach the middle, and a big asteroid that splits when hit.
Anything reaching the bottom drains energy (your HP): enemies a lot, matter a little; falling matter also blocks shots and body-checks the blob.
Stage 2 adds ruins, tough slow walls that shield the enemies behind them.
Stage 3 ends on the Mother, who spawns pods and fires spreading volleys.
Death ends the run; a new run starts fresh.
*(provisional)*
